# #8690 PERMANENT-EXCLUSION REGISTER — the classification of every line still in
# compact_block_divergences_2419.txt.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The inventory counts sites that DIVERGE. It says nothing
# about whether a site MAY be normalized, and by the end of the sweep those are
# almost disjoint questions: 47 lines remain and ~43 of them must never be
# normalized. A bare count of 47 reads as 47 units of work, and the only way to
# "finish" it is to normalize sites the guards exist to protect. This file is
# what the inventory's remainder actually means.
#
# FORMAT: <site>\t<class>\t<reason>
#
# CLASSES
#   partial          something already consumes part of the tail. Truncating it
#                    removes a value that is READ, on a config that commits
#                    clean. Forbidden to every scope by
#                    TestNormalizerScopeNeverCoversAPartialSite8690.
#   gate-open-question
#                    the disarm arm reds here: rejected at strict commit with the
#                    pass disabled, accepted with it enabled. THAT IS A QUESTION,
#                    NOT A VERDICT, and this register got it wrong at first by
#                    recording such reds as permanent.
#                    The arm cannot distinguish a gate refusing the packed
#                    SPELLING (harmful to disarm) from one refusing the
#                    CONSEQUENCE OF THE DROP — where the pass repairs the drop
#                    and the acceptance is correct. Only a person can, and the
#                    verdict's home is the `benign` map in
#                    compact_normalize_scope_8690_test.go.
#                    PROOF THAT THIS DISTINCTION IS LOAD-BEARING: `security ipsec
#                    policy <p> proposal-set` and its ike collateral were listed
#                    here as permanent on this arm's red alone. Classified, they
#                    were BENIGN — the gate refuses the dropped proposal-set and
#                    says so in its own message — and they normalized in
#                    0c4818aa0. Two of the entries this register called permanent
#                    were available work.
#                    So these are NOT permanent. They are unanswered questions,
#                    and answering one is the available work.
#   gate-confirmed   classified BY A PERSON as a genuine disarm, with the
#                    evidence. Permanent. Currently empty: no site here has been
#                    carried through step 3.
#   gate-collateral  not itself gate-disarming, but shares a (container, head)
#                    pair with a `gate` site, and the predicate's two arguments
#                    cannot express the difference. Lost with the pair.
#   unmeasurable     the census fixture cannot produce a type-valid value, so
#                    gate status cannot be measured. NOT known-safe.
#   unreachable      no (container, head) rule can express it — the container is
#                    wildcard-named, so production passes an arbitrary instance
#                    name where a rule would need a keyword.
#   hazard           normalizing breaks documented, shipped behaviour that no
#                    disarm measurement detects.
#   open             genuinely available work with no gate in the way.
#   unclassified     in another lane's family and NOT measured here. Deliberately
#                    distinct from `open`: "nobody has checked" is a third state,
#                    and recording it as available asserts a measurement that was
#                    not taken.
#
# THIS REGISTER WAS WRONG TWICE IN ITS FIRST HOUR, BOTH TIMES IN THE
# OVER-RESTRICTIVE DIRECTION, AND BOTH ERRORS HAD THE SAME SHAPE: a result
# established at one granularity, recorded at a finer one.
#
#   `security ipsec policy <p> proposal-set` (+ its ike collateral) were listed
#   permanent on the DISARM ARM'S RED. That red is a question, not a verdict —
#   the arm cannot tell a gate refusing the packed spelling from one refusing
#   the CONSEQUENCE of the drop. Classified by a person, they were BENIGN, and
#   they normalized in 0c4818aa0.
#
#   `chassis device-map interface` / `unmapped-interface-policy` were listed
#   `hazard` on a PER-FAMILY bisection: admitting every chassis pair reds three
#   redundancy-group cells. True of the family; not true of these two sites,
#   whose pairs are different. Measured per site they are safe, and they
#   normalized alongside schedulers.
#
# Four sites this file called permanent were available work. The lesson is the
# one the sweep has been applying everywhere else and this register did not:
# CHECK PER SITE, NOT PER FAMILY — and treat an instrument's red as the
# question it is until a person answers it.
#
# THIS FILE IS A GATE, NOT A REGISTRY. The guard asserts set-equality with the
# inventory in BOTH directions, and drives every non-`open` site through the
# real normalizer to confirm the pass still leaves it alone. A listed site that
# becomes admissible reds; an inventory site missing from this file reds. An
# exclusion list that only accumulates is a place to hide defects.
